description: Development regression set from two open-access 2025 papers. It was frozen before retrieval diagnostics, then reclassified after the first gate exposed generic multi-fact and table-context gaps.
freeze_policy: Do not tune retrieval, parsing, or answer formatting against this set. Any failure discovered after retrieval or generation requires reclassification as development-regression and a new unseen set.
reclassification_reason: The H8 context gate reached only 6/12 full cases; missing facts concentrated in multi-fact prose, multi-column tables, and modality-specific pipeline details. A new unseen set is required for confirmation.
